heroHeadline: Maraga Publicly Releases Long-Shelved Police Reforms Report, Alleges Uniform Procurement Graft
heroSubtitle: Former Chief Justice David Maraga makes the National Taskforce on Police Reforms report public nearly three years after handing it to Ruto, following through on his ultimatum after the government's deadline lapsed, and accuses officials of corruption and opacity in the new police uniform rollout
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
